source.title: Fine Structures of Berry Curvature and Unquantized Valley Chern Numbers in Valley Photonic Crystals
source.authors: Wei Dai, Taiki Yoda, Yuto Moritake, Masaya Notomi
locations: Section B, Berry curvatures in half-Brillouin zone and valley Chern number
source.delta_K_text_binding: Appendix B states that the shrunken K-HBZ radius is smaller than the original by delta_K.
source.delta_Gamma_text_binding: Appendix B states that the three dashed hexagons centered at Gamma points have radius delta_Gamma.
source.orientation_binding: Figure 7 qualitatively binds the exclusion hexagons to the FBZ/HBZ axes; no pixel digitization is used.
source.grid_binding: Appendix B states grid interval 1/36*(2*pi/a) for the actual calculation.

source_parameter_semantics.delta_K_units: normalized public q units corresponding to delta_K*(2*pi/a)
source_parameter_semantics.outer_boundary_construction: analytic reciprocal-lattice K-HBZ triangle; reduce its circumradius about the valley center by delta_K
source_parameter_semantics.delta_Gamma_units: normalized public q units corresponding to delta_Gamma*(2*pi/a)
source_parameter_semantics.hexagon_rotation_relative_to_public_q_ax: source-figure-aligned_with_FBZ_axes; project convention uses one hexagon vertex on +public_qx and does not digitize the figure
source_parameter_semantics.hexagon_edge_relation_to_hbz: each Gamma-centered exclusion is a regular hexagon in the source FBZ/HBZ orientation; it is an exclusion mask, not an HBZ boundary
source_parameter_semantics.hexagon_center_locations: the three Gamma-equivalent vertices of the untruncated K-HBZ
